gen-amatic-sc-gf-saira: Amatic SC scrawls in one unmodulated line, its terminals stopping well short of the stem, rustic and a bit quirky. Amatic SC charms; Saira, a sans-serif, keeps its rounded letters tidy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sarpanch: Amatic SC draws with a blunt, round-tip marker feel, end to end. Quirk is its strength, while Sarpanch, a sans-serif, does compact, approachable text with a clearly open e.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-savate: Amatic SC rounds its bowls without any swelling or tapering. Savate reads smoothly down whole paragraphs, its open-jawed curves and tall rounded o carrying a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC traces every letter with one marker, while Schibsted Grotesk offers big open e and a shapes. Give the body a little extra size so those tall bowls show.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sen: Amatic SC writes with a single casual line, its terminals stopping far from the stem. But Sen is the one built for tidy, tall lowercase, its curves ending before they turn inward.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sintony: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC builds every letter from one width of stroke, while Sintony stands chunky and tall. Handmade charm up top, smooth unclogged curves below, all of it easy going.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-slabo-13px: Amatic SC is rustic and quirky, with every stroke uniform in thickness. And Slabo 13px, a serif, reads with a bookish dignity, its big open counters keeping paragraphs inviting.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sofia-sans: Scrappy marker scrawl: Amatic SC wanders along in one steady line. Sofia Sans takes over for unvarying, stencil-like lowercase that stands tall, its rounded letters open at the side.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Toothpaste-squeezed strokes give Amatic SC its rustic, handmade look. Loose handwriting meets clean, stencil-cut order in Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sono: Amatic SC bends every curve without thinning, giving a rustic, quirky hand. Sono, a sans-serif with wide default spacing and each a left ajar, is best given a bit more size.
